message: two threads of process 65 wrote in the judged directory: tid 65 performed open(/s/grafana/data/grafana.db) and tid 67 performed open(/s/grafana/data/grafana.db-journal). Nothing the supervising engine recorded orders the first of those before the second: under --observe supervised no join is recorded, nor which thread a creation made, so however the target orders them this run cannot establish that a crash point names the same operation on the next run, and writes from two or more threads of one process refuse. The modes that load a shim, which records creations and joins, judge a process whose threads' writes they order (v18)
next_step: Two threads of one process wrote the judged directory, and under --observe supervised no join is recorded, nor which thread a creation made, so nothing orders their writes. A tool's own switch for running its file calls on one thread can move it past this — UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=1 for Node, GOMAXPROCS=1 for Go: set it in the environment Sideeye runs in and declare it in the define's apparatus (env:UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=1, for example); https://github.com/yottayoshida/sideeye/blob/v1.16.0/docs/apparatus.md#a-tools-own-switch-for-one-thread lists the switches measured and the targets each did not move.
